reminders.text: Paper book, one change to note (A18): the ten weekend sessions were loaded on 21 Nov, and the book replayed from 13 Nov on the complete bars holds CARTRADE where the digests of 13–20 Nov listed ATHERENERG. Nothing was sold — the 13 Nov ranking changed by one name. Value on 20 Nov ₹4,97,909 against ₹4,97,996 as sent (reports/weekend-sessions-2026-11-21.md).

A week on the slot ladder (18 Nov): is the digest arriving between 18:00 and 19:00 IST, as one message on a day without trades, with both momentum indices in the PAPER BOOK line? Actions → Daily NSE snapshot shows which slot did the work (19 and 20 Nov: 19:16 and 19:00 IST). If it is still hours late, set up the outside clock (README, 'When the digest is late'; checklist item under Housekeeping). Note the week's times under A16; the decision is at the 8 Dec reading.

Slot ladder, second reading (A16): list the digest times since 18 Nov and decide — mostly 18:00–18:45 IST → tick A16; 19:00 or later → add the 04:02 and 05:02 UTC slots to daily.yml; hours late → the outside clock (README, 'When the digest is late'). Has any run failed since 21 Nov, and did the alert arrive?

The twenty-one books (A21): book 21 should have started on 14 Dec — the site's card and the job's log say so. Copy the 21 start days from data/latest.json → paperBooks.starts into config.json → paper.starts, so that a session loaded later cannot move a book; then note it under A21.

Results drift, first reading (A1): the 44 PEAD trades open on 20 Nov have closed. npm run backtest:pead, then read the three conditions of the 13 Nov rule on the finished list — if any year is over 40% of the R the setup fails by the letter and is closed (on 21 Nov the largest was 2020, 35.7%; reports/pead-results-drift-reading-2026-11-21.md).

Month-end: check the paper book's month in latest.json against the fund (the book's picks are logged by the job, no manual entry needed); compare last month's momentum-pullback paper trades in the journal with the backtest's expectancy.
Monthly: re-run the two backtests on the month's new bars (npm run backtest:momentum -- --benchmarks && npm run backtest) and compare with the previous month's reports; push.
Quarterly: from home, npm run corporate-actions (new bonuses/splits), then the two backtests; check every workflow's actions/* versions and Node version are still supported.

NIFTY 500 review has taken effect (end of March / end of September): do the index-review top-up in BACKFILL.md — save the press release, the new constituent list and symbolchange.csv, rebuild the membership list, then backfill --members from home, and again a month later. Until then the paper book cannot rank the new names and carries the ones that left at a stale price.

Results drift, the paper season (A1): from home, the results-dates top-up (BACKFILL.md, 'Results dates'), then npm run backtest:pead and backtest:pead-portfolio. Read the forward season in the report's Results drift section and on the site: trades, R, excess over the NIFTY 50, the starred share against 23.6%. A record, not a verdict — rule frozen 21 Nov 2026.

Three months of the paper book (since 13 Nov 2026): is the engine, both switches on, ahead of or behind NIFTY500 MOMENTUM 50 since then, on return and on drawdown (latest.json paper, data/benchmarks/live.json; refresh the TR files from niftyindices.com for the dividend-inclusive number)? Beside it the twenty-one books' line (median, range, how many ahead) — a look, not the reading, which is on 14 Jun. Also the journal's momentum-pullback paper trades vs the backtest, and the Discretionary book's record in R (site → Performance → by book; Backup for the sentences written at entry). Write the answer into ROADMAP.md.

The twenty-one books, the reading (A21) — six months from book 21's first day; this replaces the 5 May reading of book 1 alone. First the five data conditions in reports/momentum-books-reading-rule-2026-11-23.md (start days frozen, a fund close on every first day and today, the March index-review top-up, corporate actions, no missing session). Then: node scripts/paper-books.mjs --to <today> --write. Ahead = median gap +1.0 point or more and 14 of 21 books ahead; anything else → the desk stays a monitor and the fund stays the holding. An 'ahead' opens the call on real money (owner, 23 Nov 2026): read the books as the actual investment — the script prints the median margin over the fund in rupees on ₹5,00,000 — and decide whether it is tangible, with the history beside it (an 'ahead' came up in 36% of past half years on rules level with the fund). Read the Discretionary book the same way: its expectancy in R beside the books and the fund — a record, never a reason to change a rule. Then, if everything above is ticked, schedule the final audit session (README, Housekeeping).
